author: Andrés Segovia
quote: The guitar is a small orchestra: every string speaks with its own voice.

author: Agustín Barrios Mangoré
quote: Music begins where words lose their courage.

author: Paco de Lucía
quote: Play as though the strings were breathing, not counting.

author: Django Reinhardt
quote: Three fingers are enough when the heart knows the whole fretboard.

author: Jimi Hendrix
quote: A sound must be seen before it can be heard.

author: Francisco Tárrega
quote: The instrument is patient; only the player is in a hurry.

author: Heitor Villa-Lobos
quote: Every melody is a road that leads back to whoever wrote it.

author: Julian Bream
quote: The silence between the notes belongs to the score as well.
